title: How does IKEA come up with names for its products?
summary: IKEA's product naming system uses a carefully designed methodology where different product categories have distinct naming rules: furniture uses Swedish forestry names, bathroom items use lakes/rivers, beds use Norwegian place names, and fabrics use Islamic names. The company has an internal 'naming committee' that ensures all names meet specific criteria before approval.
problem_solved: Explains how IKEA creates memorable, culturally-appropriate, and systematic product names across thousands of items worldwide.
why_valuable: Reveals the strategic thinking behind one of the world's most recognizable retail naming systems, demonstrating how systematic naming can build global brand consistency while maintaining cultural sensitivity.
